verse.verse_1: THE AVARICE OF plenitude keeps you occupied
verse.verse_3: But you will come to know soon; --
verse.verse_4: Indeed you will come to know soon.
verse.verse_5: And yet if you knew with positive knowledge
verse.verse_6: You have indeed to behold Hell;
verse.verse_7: Then you will see it with the eye of certainty.
verse.verse_8: Then on that day you will surely be asked about the verity of pleasures.
